<!-- The block panics after the marker, so the full run fails. The exit run stops before the panic and must succeed — the expectation comes from the div. The marker counts as a hidden line: the panic at `main.go:10` shows as `main.go:9`. -->

```{.go .run .output .expect-failure}
package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
	fmt.Println("before")
	// exit: safe
	var m map[string]int
	fmt.Println("after")
	m["x"] = 1
}
```
